== Notes ==
*The bonus percentage is added to resurrection skills' levels of health and energy, rather than modifying these levels by a factor.
**For example, a rank 15 "We Shall Return!" (PvP) used with [[Resurrection Signet]] will give the [[target]] 75% energy, not 37.5%.
*To use this skill with [[Lively Was Naomei]], it needs to be active when you drop the ashes.
*This skill does not affect [[Restoration (PvP)]].
